findings.fix: Reduce the powers uniformly before the case split — a single lemma `complexRoot 3 ^ n = complexRoot 3 ^ (n % 3)` (from `IsPrimitiveRoot.pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq`) or the geometric-sum identity `IsPrimitiveRoot.geom_sum_eq_zero` (Mathlib/RingTheory/RootsOfUnity/PrimitiveRoots.lean:444) — then close each case with one `linear_combination`. Drop the `| skip` alternative so no branch can silently do nothing.
findings.issue: The nine-case terminal block is `fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> (simp [...]; ring_nf <;> (first | simp only [hpow_three, hpow_four, hpow_five, hpow_six] | skip) <;> first | linear_combination ... | norm_num)`: a non-terminal `simp` feeding `ring_nf`, whose exact normal form (which of ζ^3..ζ^6 appear) decides which branch of the `first` fires, with `| skip` making the patch step a silent no-op in some cases. Any change in `simp`/`ring_nf` output breaks all nine goals at once with no localized failure.

findings.fix: Replace all three with one reusable statement about powers of `complexRoot 3` modulo 3 (see previous finding), or a single `simp [pow_succ, pow_add, hpow_three]` step.
findings.issue: `hpow_four`, `hpow_five`, `hpow_six` are three near-identical two-step `calc` blocks (14 lines) proving ζ^4=ζ, ζ^5=ζ², ζ^6=1 by splitting off ζ^3 with `ring`. This is the same reasoning written three times, inline, and it exists only to repair `ring_nf`'s output.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:472-476 (`@[simp] theorem star_complexRoot`); CyclicThree.lean:331 is the only occurrence outside Basic.lean, and it suppresses the lemma.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from `star_complexRoot` and mark `star_complexRoot_eq_pow` `@[simp]` instead (powers are what the table proofs use), so the use site can be a plain `simp`.
findings.issue: `star_complexRoot` is added with `@[simp]` (normal form `(complexRoot e)⁻¹`), but its only in-repo consumer immediately turns it off: `simp [-Cyclotomic.star_complexRoot, Cyclotomic.star_complexRoot_eq_pow]`. The PR chooses a simp normal form it then has to fight, which is a hidden fragility for any later proof mixing the two forms.

findings.evidence: IntegerChecker.lean:141-142 and 149-150; `Mathlib/Data/Int/Cast/Lemmas.lean:92: @[simp] lemma coe_castRingHom : ⇑(castRingHom α) = fun x : ℤ ↦ (x : α)`.
findings.fix: Finish with `simp` or `rw [Int.coe_castRingHom]` instead of `rfl`, at both IntegerChecker.lean:142 and IntegerChecker.lean:150.
findings.issue: Both refactored lemmas now end with a bare `rfl` closing the wrapper gap `(Int.castRingHom ℂ) x = (x : ℂ)`, i.e. relying on undocumented defeq between a `RingHom` coercion and the `Int.cast` coercion, where a named lemma exists.

summary: The row-orthonormality proof is closed by a non-terminal `simp` plus a `ring_nf`-shape-dependent combinator with a silent `skip` branch, propped up by three hand-rolled power identities; and the PR adds `star_complexRoot` as `@[simp]` only to disable it at its sole use site.
